name: Toe Touchers
instructions: Lie on the floor with your arms across your sides, palms down.
Slowly raise your legs until they're almost perpendicular to the floor with a slight bend at the knees. This is the starting position.
Keeping your lower back pressed against the floor, slowly lift your torso and reach with your hands to try and touch your toes.
Slowly lower your torso and arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
